**1 — Scene:** A light breakfast of fruit toast, cooked mushrooms, sliced avocado and a small bowl of strawberries. I include the central plate and strawberry bowl, but exclude the peripheral cereal, yogurt, banana and drinks.

**2 — Vessels:** The main plate appears about **22 cm** across: area = 3.14 × 11² ≈ **380 cm²**. The strawberry bowl is approximately **9 cm** across: area ≈ **64 cm²**.

**3 — Items:** Fruit toast, mushrooms, avocado and strawberries. No distinct sauce or measurable oil is visible.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy:**

| Item | Vessel area covered | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Fruit toast | 23% of plate | 87 × 2.0 = 174 ml | 0.30 g/ml | 52 g | 300 | 156 kcal |
| Cooked mushrooms | 26% of plate | 99 × 1.3 = 129 ml | 0.60 g/ml | 77 g | 40 | 31 kcal |
| Avocado | 14% of plate | 53 × 0.9 = 48 ml | 0.95 g/ml | 45 g | 160 | 72 kcal |
| Strawberries | 65% of bowl | 42 × 2.0 = 84 ml | 0.60 g/ml | 50 g | 32 | 16 kcal |

The main-plate coverage totals **63%**, consistent with the visible uncovered rim and gaps.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **224 g and 275 kcal** is plausible for one substantial slice of toast, a modest mushroom portion, several avocado slices and a small bowl of berries. Cooking fat, if present but not discernible, would increase the energy.
